concept: A cozy play lounge where bright challenges, shared adventures, and satisfying stopping points turn focused gaming into restorative play.
floor: One broad continuous deep-indigo playroom carpet across the full top face, divided into only four to six oversized softly joined panels without pixels, grids, rugs, paths, or repeated texture.
main_structure: One broad open-front teal-and-violet arcade lounge at the rear with a rounded canopy, one large blank dark display, and two oversized simple controller-button forms built into the frame.
rear_props: one broad low game console with one oversized controller and three large unmarked buttons
two large cyan-and-gold playroom lanterns flanking the rear lounge
side_props: one chunky curved sofa with two oversized cushion blocks on the upper-left edge
one broad closed game chest and three oversized puzzle-block forms on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth teal-and-indigo playroom border with broad violet capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple controller-button and puzzle-block emblems

materials: a few broad violet and warm-gold blocks

lighting: soft cozy evening light from one broad display glow and two large cyan-gold lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open deep-indigo carpet
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, person, hand, or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, game board, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable screen content, text, logos, watermark, external shadow
tiny pixels, button labels, cables, cartridges, score displays, specks, confetti, or dense clutter
